skins.name: Dark Cloud
skins.description: Mountain's attire at his parents' funeral. Though he personally slew his own enemy, there is no hint of joy in his heart. There are still things he needs to do.

skins.name: Return
skins.description: Ægir Consul Gladiia's attire as she led her unit to return to the sea. Following sufficient exchange with the nations of dry land, the Ægir found themselves fully prepared to return to the home they'd left.

skins.name: Black Wave
skins.description: Stage clothing picked by guitarist Vigna herself. The outfit in whole has been languishing in Vigna's wardrobe for a while, and she's always wanted to give it a stage showing. The chance has now arrived.

skins.name: Forgemaster
skins.description: Rhodes Island Engineering Chief Eunectes's outfit while refitting an experimental-model Raging Ironhide . Every point worked on all by herself, everyone saying she's much more reliable than Closure . Closure fiercely rolling her eyes.

skins.name: Gorgeous Flower
skins.description: Flint's attire when she set out on a lone journey, a " Catastrophe Messenger " by her own declaration. Before, her fists only knew Acahualla and Rhodes Island . Now, it's Terra 's turn.

skins.name: Professional
skins.description: The outfit Spot wore for an Annihilation mission promo. It might've been effective, but all Spot's thinking about is what cartoons are on tonight.
skins.howToObtain: Gift of the Deep Ones Sign-In Event (Day 10)

skins.name: Tested One
skins.description: Ayerscarpe's attire while upgrading the Rim Billiton Weapon Distribution Center weapons system. He needs to infiltrate a Catastrophe area together with his friends, and heist an important piece of data back before the Columbians .

skins.name: Burst Feline
skins.description: Stage clothing picked by drummer Blaze herself. There might not be much material, but it's breathable, sweat-absorbent and flame-resistant, ensuring no outfit malfunctions will affect Blaze's performance.

skins.name: Speechless Sound
skins.description: Stage clothing picked by bassist Courier himself. People think of Kjerag 's men as steadfast and untalkative, but Courier's ready with his bass to change their perception.
